name: skills-catalog
description: A small personal catalog of generic product and engineering skills for Claude Code

plugins.name: acceptance-criteria-writer
plugins.description: Turn a feature or user story description into clear, testable acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then form, including edge cases and what is out of scope. Use when someone asks for acceptance criteria, a definition of done for a story, or "how will we know this works".

plugins.name: changelog-from-commits
plugins.description: Write a user-facing changelog from git commits

plugins.name: code-review-checklist
plugins.description: Review a change against a practical checklist and report findings by severity

plugins.name: incident-postmortem
plugins.description: Blameless incident postmortems: a writer skill plus a timeline-builder agent that turns messy logs into a clean timeline

plugins.name: meeting-agenda-builder
plugins.description: Turns a meeting goal, length and attendees into a timed agenda with a clear outcome for each item. Use when someone asks for a meeting agenda, wants to plan a workshop or kickoff, or says "help me run this meeting".

plugins.name: meeting-to-actions
plugins.description: Turn meeting notes into decisions, owners and dates

plugins.name: metrics-review
plugins.description: Review a product metric and pair it with guardrail metrics

plugins.name: prd-writer
plugins.description: Turn a rough idea into a one-page PRD

plugins.name: publish-skill
plugins.description: Publish a skill to this catalog through a pull request

plugins.name: release-notes-checker
plugins.description: Check draft release notes before publishing, for missing breaking changes, unclear wording, internal jargon and inconsistent formatting.

plugins.name: repo-health-check
plugins.description: Check a repository for missing basics, large files, stale branches and open TODOs

plugins.name: retro-facilitator
plugins.description: Run a team retrospective from raw notes or sticky-note dumps, grouping themes and turning them into a few owned improvement actions. Use after a sprint, project or incident when a team wants to reflect and improve.

plugins.name: risk-register-builder
plugins.description: Turns a project description or a list of worries into a scored risk register with an owner and a next action for each risk. Use when someone asks for a risk register, a risk assessment, "what could go wrong", or wants to prepare risks for a planning or steering meeting.

plugins.name: standup-summary
plugins.description: Turn commits and notes into a three-line standup update

plugins.name: test-plan-writer
plugins.description: Write a risk-based test plan with cases by level, test data and exit criteria

plugins.name: user-story-splitter
plugins.description: Split a large story into thin, shippable slices with acceptance criteria
